answer: The funding atlas is checked before any transaction. The first identity from a wallet earns sparrow status and burns 50 copper tokens to register. Every further identity from that wallet loses sparrow status and the burn triples: 150 for the second, 450 for the third. An honest agent pays 50 copper once; an operator funding 20 fakes burns more than 87 billion copper, while verification costs one lookup. Burn receipts stay in the atlas, so the ladder never resets. One fake caught taints the cluster, like a toll gate tripling the fare for every extra passenger.
